title: Worklist tile day-window boundaries
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. These are number and date accuracy cases: enter the exact inputs, read the value the screen shows, and compare it with the value worked out below.
  3. A schedule "Window check" (by a user with Settings Service) with services, each with default reminder rows: "D30" Every 30 days; "D31" Every 31 days; "D91" Every 91 days; "D92" Every 92 days; "NR200" Every 200 days plus Distance Every 15,000 mileage.
  4. Enrol test asset 1 (one with no mileage reading, for NR200) with every last service date left blank: due dates are then today + 30, + 31, + 91, + 92 and + 200.
  5. Enrol test asset 2 on a schedule "Today check" with "T30" Every 30 days and last service date = 30 days before today (due today), and test asset 3 on the same schedule with last service date = 31 days before today (due yesterday).
custom_steps:
1. With no tile active, look for each seeded row.
  2. Activate each time tile in turn and note which seeded rows it shows.
  3. Activate Needs readings and note which seeded rows it shows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Listed with no tile: asset 3 (overdue), asset 2 (due today), D30, D31, D91 and NR200; D92 is not listed (+92 is beyond the 91 days).
  • Overdue shows asset 3 (due before today); Due in a month shows asset 2 (today) and D30 (+30); Due in 3 months shows D31 (+31) and D91 (+91).
  • Needs readings shows NR200 although it is +200 days out.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R2, S13-R36, S13-R43); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R36: “With no tile active the list shows every row that is overdue, due today or due within the next 91 days, plus every Needs readings row whatever its date. A service further out is not listed”
  • S13-R2: “Overdue: due before today. Due in a month: today up to 30 days ahead. Due in 3 months: 31 to 91 days ahead”
  • S13-R43: “A Needs readings row stays listed, per S13-R36. Every other completion rests the row, including a last service date entered at enrolment”
